list-deal-client-publications.output: partner drafts and published records with versions

set-client-publication.content: text for milestone/document/tour/report; deliverable_id and deliverable_version (required exact current version) for deliverable

invariants: Only authenticated partners Joe and Dell or their verified partner-authority agents may author or preview a deal the sponsoring partner can access. Publication rows use the partner identity; audit events retain the actual actor.
The password-authenticated read-client-portal and partner preview use the same projection.
Milestones remain hidden until explicitly published. Live deal phases are never automatically projected.
Deliverables must remain finalized, shared, same-deal and at the exact published version.
Published file metadata contains id, filename, MIME and byte count. It contains no object key or download capability.
Tour text publication does not create or edit a tour. Tours are authored inside deals.
Publication never sends, deploys or grants a public CARR mutation route. Hosting and download delivery are separate jobs.
consumer_note: Consumers must render publications (including milestone items), treat roadmap as empty, and never infer visibility from a file's shared designation alone. This is an additive portal payload field with an intentional removal of automatic phase exposure.
conflict_resolution: WR586 CLIENT-VIEW is later than WR227 AC2. Published milestones replace automatic live-phase exposure. Roadmap remains an empty compatibility shape. Existing portal URL/password/session behavior is unchanged.
write_recovery: Retry the identical command with the identical UUID idempotency key after an unknown outcome. A different payload reusing that key fails key_reuse. Re-read the authored list to reconcile a version conflict. Withdrawal remains allowed when the existing linked file has become private or stale; it preserves the pinned file identity and never exposes it.
